name: profile_depth_vs_width
invariant: Equal event count does not imply equal dependency depth (COMPLEXITY.md section 10, Counterexample 1). H1 is a sequential chain a->b->c->d; H2 pops the same four objects with no binds at all. Both have event count 4 (in the pop-only prefix used for the graph), but D(H1)=4, W(H1)=1 while D(H2)=1, W(H2)=4.
explanation: Depth is computed as the longest dependency path counted in vertices under the default assembly interpretation (a bind(a,b) edge is read as 'b depends on a'); width is the maximum antichain size, computed exactly via Dilworth/Mirsky duality (min chain cover of the reachability relation).
